record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Functional Analysis and Function Theory
record.context_brief: Weak embeddings of L1: Gδ to semi
record.original_question: If L_1 G_delta-embeds in a Banach space X, must L_1 semi-embed in X, meaning that there is an injective operator T in L(L_1,X) for which T(B_{L_1}) is closed?

evidence.quote: Definition 13.1. (H.P. Lotz, N.T. Peck, H. Porta, 1979) An injective operator T ∈ L(X, Y ) is called a semi-embedding if T BX is closed.
Definition 13.2. (J. Bourgain, H.P. Rosenthal, 1983) An injective operator T ∈ L(X, Y ) is called a Gδ-embedding if TK is a Gδ-set for each closed bounded K ⊂ X.
B) Suppose that L1 Gδ-embeds in X. Does L1 semi-embed in X?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X and Y be (real) Banach spaces and let L(X,Y) denote the space of bounded linear operators from X to Y. Write B_X for the closed unit ball of X, and let K range over closed bounded subsets of X.

Recall the following definitions:
(i) An injective operator T ∈ L(X,Y) is called a semi-embedding if T(B_X) is closed in Y.
(ii) An injective operator T ∈ L(X,Y) is called a Gδ-embedding if T(K) is a Gδ-subset of Y for every closed bounded set K ⊂ X.

Let L_1 = L_1[0,1] be the usual Lebesgue space. Suppose that there exists a Gδ-embedding from L_1 into a Banach space X.

Question: Must there then exist a semi-embedding from L_1 into X, i.e., an injective operator T ∈ L(L_1, X) such that T(B_{L_1}) is closed in X?
artifact.status_search_result: The notions of semi-embedding (Lotz–Peck–Porta, 1979) and Gδ-embedding (Bourgain–Rosenthal, 1983) are well established, and the relationship between Gδ-embeddings and semi-embeddings of L_1 into a Banach space has been studied since the 1980s. A definitive resolution of whether every Gδ-embedding of L_1 implies a semi-embedding of L_1 was not located in the available search results, so the current status appears unresolved/unknown from this search.

status_evidence.title: Applications of the theory of semi-embeddings to Banach space theory
status_evidence.snippet: Bourgain and Rosenthal develop the theory of semi-embeddings and Gδ-embeddings, including results on L_1.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the foundational definitions and results on Gδ- and semi-embeddings of L_1 but does not record a resolution of the implication in question.

status_evidence.title: Martingales, Gδ-embeddings and quotients of L_1 (Math. Ann. 264, 1983)
status_evidence.snippet: Bourgain–Rosenthal study Gδ-embeddings of L_1 and quotients.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on Gδ-embeddings of L_1; does not appear to settle whether Gδ-embeddability of L_1 implies semi-embeddability.
